abilities.name: Improved Barrier
abilities.text: Use when this Unit is selected as the target of an attack. If this Unit has the Shielded Status, the Damage characteristic of the attacking weapon is treated as a maximum of 1 for this attack.

abilities.name: Indomitable
abilities.text: While Engaged, this Unit may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy Units. In both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade Roll against those attacks.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (4) 3+ effect.

upgrades.name: Shield Overcharge
upgrades.text: Use before this Unit makes an Armour Roll. If this Unit has the Shielded Status, It gains TOUGH (2) for this roll.

upgrades.name: Fury Unyielding
upgrades.text: While this Unit is Within 3″ of a Mission Marker, its Ranged Weapons gain CRITICAL HIT (1) when targeting an Enemy Unit that is also Within 3″ of that same Mission Marker.

upgrades.name: For the Ancients
upgrades.text: When this Unit makes a Ranged Attack, if the target Unit is more than 8″ away, the attacking weapons gain PRECISION (1).
